Texas executes Jamaal Howard after concerns over lethal injection drug

Texas executed Jamaal Howard on Tuesday, marking the first execution in the state since concerns arose over the lethal injection drug used in a prior failed execution in Tennessee. The execution proceeded despite these concerns.
